title: First release: publish the unsigned Windows and Mac installers on GitHub Releases
summary: Published Grillo 0.1.0, the first public version, with unsigned Windows and Mac installers and the update files on GitHub Releases; no files changed, so there was no pull request and the evidence is on the issue.
lessons_learned: GitHub Actions runs again since the repository went public on 2026-11-03 (CI and release runs green), so the CLAUDE.md rule that treats the project as having no CI is out of date and makes runs skip a CI that exists
